children: announced on Thursday that it agreed to acquire private water midstream company Pilot Water Solutions for $700M in cash and stock, plus up to $15M in additional contingent consideration.
, the company will pay $600M in cash and $100M in Class A shares, with debt financing commitments from JPMorgan Chase
The deal is expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and other closing conditions.
Pilot Water is expected to generate $100M–$110M of adjusted EBITDA in 2026, rising to $120M–$130M in 2027.
Meanwhile, Select Water also expects $10M–$15M in annual cost synergies within 12–18 months after closing.
The acquisition will add more than 700 miles of pipelines and significant disposal capacity to Select’s water infrastructure business in the Delaware Basin.
Combined contracted water volumes are expected to exceed 2.5M barrels per day in 2027, strengthening the company’s recurring, contract-backed revenue base.
The company expects pro forma net leverage to remain below 2.0x at closing.

title: Select Water to buy Pilot Water in a $700M cash-and-stock deal
